what_this_is: How an automation says what sets it off, per kind of record (src/work-workflows.mjs sayWhen, and the default name of a rule in src/automations.mjs). Each value finishes the sentence 'When ...'. A kind with no row here reads 'When a <kind> is recorded', with 'an' before a vowel. Adding a kind's words is one row.
